component.name: aws2-step-functions
component.title: AWS StepFunctions
component.description: Manage the state machines and activities of AWS Step Functions, and start, stop and inspect their executions.
component.label: cloud,serverless

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsStepFunctionsOperation header replaces this option.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a StartExecutionRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

region.description: The AWS region of Step Functions, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of Step Functions trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true, and then the AWS SDK does not put the sync- prefix before its host for startSyncExecution.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

awsSfnClient.label: advanced
awsSfnClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.sfn.SfnClient. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Step Functions connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Step Functions connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Step Functions uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless awsSfnClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless awsSfnClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs, as text or as a StepFunctions2Operations. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsStateMachineName.description: The name of the state machine that createStateMachine creates.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsStateMachineDefinit.description: The definition of the state machine in the Amazon States Language, as JSON text, for createStateMachine and updateStateMachine.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsStateMachineType.description: The type of the state machine that createStateMachine creates: STANDARD or EXPRESS, as text or as a StateMachineType. If not set, Step Functions creates a STANDARD state machine, and the type cannot be changed later.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsStateMachineRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that the state machine uses, for createStateMachine and updateStateMachine.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsStateMachineArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the state machine, for deleteStateMachine, updateStateMachine, describeStateMachine, startExecution, startSyncExecution and listExecutions. To start or list executions, it can also be the ARN of a version or an alias of the state machine.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsStateMachinesMaxRes.description: The maximum number of state machines that listStateMachines returns, at most 1000. If not set or 0, Step Functions returns up to 100. The response holds one page only, with a nextToken when there are more.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsActivityName.description: The name of the activity that createActivity creates.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsActivityArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the activity, for deleteActivity, describeActivity and getActivityTask.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsActivitiesMaxResult.description: The maximum number of activities that listActivities returns, at most 1000. If not set or 0, Step Functions returns up to 100. The response holds one page only, with a nextToken when there are more.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the execution, for stopExecution, describeExecution and getExecutionHistory.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionName.description: The name of the execution that startExecution or startSyncExecution starts, at most 80 characters. If not set, Step Functions generates a UUID as the name.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionInput.description: The JSON input data of the execution that startExecution or startSyncExecution starts, as text (a String, a byte array or a stream). A value of another type, such as a Map, fails the exchange: marshal it to JSON first.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionStatus.label: startSyncExecution
CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionStatus.description: The status of the execution: SUCCEEDED, FAILED or TIMED_OUT. The exchange does not fail when the execution did not succeed: check this header.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionError.label: startSyncExecution
CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionError.description: The error code of the failure, when the execution failed.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionCause.label: startSyncExecution
CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionCause.description: The cause of the failure, when the execution failed.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionTraceHeade.description: The AWS X-Ray trace header of the execution that startExecution or startSyncExecution starts.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionHistoryMax.description: The maximum number of events that getExecutionHistory returns, at most 1000. If not set or 0, Step Functions returns up to 100. The response holds one page only, with a nextToken when there are more.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionHistoryInc.description: Whether getExecutionHistory returns the execution data, that is the input and output of the history events. If not set, Step Functions returns it.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionHistoryRev.description: Whether getExecutionHistory lists the events in descending order of their timestamp, the latest first. If not set, the events are in ascending order.

CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionMaxResults.description: The maximum number of executions of the state machine that listExecutions returns, at most 1000. If not set or 0, Step Functions returns up to 100. The response holds one page only, with a nextToken when there are more.

producerIn.description: Not used: the operations take their input from headers, such as the input of startExecution and startSyncExecution in the CamelAwsStepFunctionsExecutionInput header as JSON text: marshal a Map or a POJO first. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a StartExecutionRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the StartExecutionResponse of startExecution with the ARN of the execution. startSyncExecution gives a StartSyncExecutionResponse whose output is the JSON that the execution returns, as text: a failed execution does not fail the exchange, so check its status

label.description: A logical name of the endpoint, which you choose freely. The producer does not use it: the state machine, activity or execution to act on is given in headers.
